211e21b943c9fb072ec76da69318a9117ded59c3.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Task selection, experience, tooling, concurrency and quality standards are comparable. Automation may redistribute comprehension and review work; record what humans and tools actually inspected.
211e21b943c9fb072ec76da69318a9117ded59c3.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Repository, model/data/configuration and concurrent-change dependencies exceed isolated-function benchmarks.

definitions.62170eb4fea4b626ff9ac3bee1a34fd3300c49e3: Individually useful controls can become redundant or too costly in combination. The required communication function is usable, accurate, scope-bound response information. 622da929ea4196c5ca7fc94d9c74aeb5b36ffe79.cost_of_simplification: Direct local evidence gives up broad explanatory comparisons; this is acceptable when population and measurement conditions are not established.
622da929ea4196c5ca7fc94d9c74aeb5b36ffe79.fuller_form_trigger: A growth, complexity, effort or quality law is used to explain or predict an actual system.
622da929ea4196c5ca7fc94d9c74aeb5b36ffe79.minimal_adequate_alternative: Use direct local evidence without invoking a law when the classification or measurement adds no decision value.
622da929ea4196c5ca7fc94d9c74aeb5b36ffe79.protected_mechanism: Declare system population, time scale, metric and conditional clauses before applying an evolution regularity; compare plausible alternative interpretations.
622da929ea4196c5ca7fc94d9c74aeb5b36ffe79.retirement_condition: Observe at a scale where results can change decisions; retire unused dashboards or metrics. Include measurement cost and the option of a stable useful system.

62345cbea4b0ce61bba051a421db9acb35126ab6.additional_qualification: The historical categories remain useful. Supersession concerns the universal claim, not the correctness of every classification made with four labels.
62345cbea4b0ce61bba051a421db9acb35126ab6.discriminating_evaluation: Contrast purpose-based classification with observed non-code work and the complementary dimensions of Buckley; one legitimate activity partition outside the asserted ontology defeats exhaustiveness.
62345cbea4b0ce61bba051a421db9acb35126ab6.scope_and_quantification: The rejected proposition quantifies over every maintenance activity, context and edition: exactly four categories exhaust the field.

definitions.623655f8870f5a7d281b93881d728b74a06dd91e: A trusted narrow assertion may suffice for a simple obligation; do not build a specification language merely for appearance. Compare analysis, execution, diagnosis, validation and delayed-feedback costs. Remove stale checks only after examining the obligation they protected; retest-all is often cheapest for small suites.

626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.BASELINE_AND_AFFECTED_ARTEFACTS: Documents, configuration, datasets, schemas, build recipes and generated outputs. Identify issue text, reference patch, model/tool version, prompt, dataset, harness, repository state and non-code dependencies.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: A non-code edit can alter buildability, operation, user guidance, data semantics or model behaviour. Generated patches, suggested merges and changed learned components are candidate interventions, not self-validating outcomes.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Generated or learned-component changes still owe the applicable interface, schema and version-combination obligations.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: The artefact’s purpose and relevant effect path are understood. Automation may redistribute comprehension and review work; record what humans and tools actually inspected.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Repository, model/data/configuration and concurrent-change dependencies exceed isolated-function benchmarks.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: A factual documentation correction may need reader/source verification, not an entire executable test suite. Measure total work and compute over an appropriate horizon; discontinue assistance when its net payoff or evidence boundary deteriorates.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Maintainers and reviewers receive proposed changes, assumptions and counterevidence; affected stakeholders resolve unclear objectives.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Weak tests, contaminated history, issue/PR mismatch and manual uncertainty constrain benchmark and patch claims.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: The actual reader, builder, runtime or downstream data consumer. Correctness follows justified requirements and relevant observations, not necessarily identity to one reference patch.
626a9375fc2f818e1c4c4fb42e228878f7ff59f6.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Tools have no intrinsic deployment authority; actual effects must retain justified containment, restoration or forward-repair choices.

628862f5038de1bc5b15eeb3c0dfd4541db9555e.mechanism: Align skills, capacity, incentives and cost allocation with the intended shared-production responsibilities; scale commitments to actual capability.
628862f5038de1bc5b15eeb3c0dfd4541db9555e.postcondition: Accepted shared work has capacity and ownership, and product teams can obtain needed support without hidden unpaid obligations.

62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Coexistence requires a supported version/state protocol and an account of which representation is authoritative.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Validated conversion, feasible operating window and explicit recovery/forward limits. Undocumented domain knowledge and imperfect data semantics can dominate migration difficulty.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Identify cutover seams, dual writes, external consumers and transitions where old/new states cannot be kept equivalent.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Prefer bounded repair or incremental transfer where they meet obligations with less risk. Include temporary duplication, conversion and exit costs; keep old service only while justified and actually close retired paths.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Legacy experts, successor maintainers, operators and affected customers must coordinate cutover and accepted losses.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Endpoint tests do not establish intermediate-state integrity; reconciliation and failed-observation paths are necessary.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: Users accepting the transition and operators performing it. Migration invariants specify what users, data consumers and operators must continue to observe and what may deliberately change.
62a36e48a6116e8295b35057590a6e808909f062.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Locate irreversible conversion or external-effect steps; distinguish true reversal from loss-tolerant restore and forward reconciliation.

62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.BASELINE_AND_AFFECTED_ARTEFACTS: Deferred liability, prospective demand and revisit condition. A debt item links a concrete design/implementation condition to affected future work and its economic context.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: Future change demand is uncertain, interest is small, or the system may retire before repayment benefits arise. Define a future-change liability, not every defect, missing feature or disliked structure as technical debt.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Debt repayment may itself impose incompatible changes; make those migration assumptions explicit.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Delay must not violate present obligations or create unacceptable irreversible lock-in. Estimates require domain and maintenance experience; uncertainty about future change demand is irreducible.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Liabilities can be local or architectural; dependencies and changing objectives alter who incurs interest.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Do nothing beyond existing observation when there is no live liability; immediate repair dominates when an obligation is already breached. Compare repayment, servicing, deferral and retirement; extinguish items when their future-cost mechanism or relevant system disappears.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Technical and business decision makers, maintainers and downstream cost bearers communicate trade-offs without blame.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Debt scanners and self-reported effort do not establish recoverable causal savings; compare plausible alternatives.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: Those bearing future effort and present opportunity cost. The payoff is reduced justified lifecycle cost or enabled value; a changed static metric is merely a proxy.
62fd5606fc423aa45ee750bfdc80bfb5ad8ada43.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Economic analysis is non-operative until an intervention is authorised; repayment then needs its own release/recovery evidence.

The intended difference determines which dependency paths matter; a documentation-only update and a schema rewrite need different propagation inquiries.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Identify supported version/schema combinations when dependencies cross deployment or ecosystem boundaries; consumers may upgrade independently.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: A common baseline, both change intents, buildable merged artefact and supported analysis semantics. The maintainer must understand enough semantics to interpret a candidate edge; a high-confidence predictor cannot replace that interpretation.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Label each edge as declared, structurally inferred, dynamically observed or historically correlated and state its guard. Challenge missed paths proportional to consequence.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Independent changes with a justified disjoint impact boundary may need only normal combined regression. Balance broader investigation against false-positive work. Stop maintaining dependency representations when no decision consumes them, not while hidden critical dependencies remain.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Change authors and integrators resolve intended interaction; a detector cannot infer stakeholder intent from information flow alone.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: The inspected study trades greater static recall for lower precision; many cases reuse earlier datasets and unsupported cases limit generality. Test selected impact hypotheses and plausible omissions. Tool recall on reused benchmark cases does not guarantee target recall.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: Consequential interactions are accepted, corrected or kept unresolved before the combined release decision. Impacted observers include direct callers, data readers, operators and combined changes. Preserve their accepted obligations, not every correlation in history.
9d6ceb15398e7e50f80e5e59d46eecfdd58ac094.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: A broader impact boundary can require staged release, forward repair or coordinated recovery. A local source revert may not reverse propagated effects.

9db8e8818f0b734e269d2a49f81222c6ab8e4814.APPLICABLE_FACET: Contributing formulation in its stated trigger and domain; not an extra mandatory control.

9dde0ede02ca82d43cba199b173e3e373fe76492.ORIGINAL_CRITICISM_ATTRIBUTION_RULE: A cited study supplies only its inspected findings. The generalisation, cheap-path comparison and disposition are analytical judgements unless explicitly attributed to the source.

9de18449f4a6a23d2fb16721b04786022f4fda97.discriminating_evaluation: Run known relevant pass/fail controls and distinguish failures, skips, stale binaries and harness exceptions.
9de18449f4a6a23d2fb16721b04786022f4fda97.scope_and_quantification: For the exact harness, artefact, environment and result interpretation used in a consequential decision.

definitions.9de89df25fd4f2ffac9d945ed8634a088ce08d7e: Evidence depends on the actual object, version, product, observer, purpose and horizon relevant to its claim. The exact structural witness also matches organization, system, period, deployment and relation kind through a checked mapping. Different keys cannot be merged into a common conclusion; irrelevant indexes need not be imposed.

9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.BASELINE_AND_AFFECTED_ARTEFACTS: Source, compiler, packaging tools, dependencies, environment and released artefact. Bind tests, results, build inputs, artefact identity, environment, deployed versions and relevant data state.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: Attribution, support, archival reuse or supply-chain checks depend on connecting source and delivered artefacts. Separate the newly intended effect from independent obligations intended to survive a release.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Mixed versions and schema transitions require accepted intermediate states, not just endpoint compatibility.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: The chosen reproducibility notion and external inputs are declared. Maintainers must know test and environment omissions, while operators must understand release and recovery conditions.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Test selection and release sampling cover declared dependency/traffic boundaries; shared state can defeat assumed isolation.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: For a directly interpreted single file, version identity and execution environment may be enough; do not mandate byte-identical builds without a consumer. Testing and rollout costs must be proportional to loss exposure; remove redundant checks, not the last evidence for a live obligation.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Developers, release operators and downstream users exchange version identity, acceptance evidence, exposure decisions and incident observations.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Tests can encode old faults, miss rare behaviour or use broken harnesses; independent evidence must address consequential omissions.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: Maintainer or downstream party comparing built outputs. An oracle is a source of expected behaviour with assumptions, not the fact that a test happened to pass.
9e32c6c05d358d233107e0e29e9e2b2871f5766f.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Specify whether recovery means code reversion, data restoration, compensation, containment or forward repair, with evidence of feasibility.

9e3dd44a0a09ba8cb3f38af58a7fabc0a62513f5.postcondition: The accepted containment objective is achieved within its loss and authority boundary, with recovery or permanent resolution still owned.

9e51cfd58de9ba49332e3b53b928599f2e830f0a.cost_of_simplification: A small practical task samples only part of capability; broaden demonstrations when the new responsibility spans materially different operations.
9e51cfd58de9ba49332e3b53b928599f2e830f0a.fuller_form_trigger: Ownership transfer, new maintainer onboarding or impending loss of specialised knowledge.
9e51cfd58de9ba49332e3b53b928599f2e830f0a.minimal_adequate_alternative: Pair on one meaningful change or diagnosis instead of producing a comprehensive handover manual.
9e51cfd58de9ba49332e3b53b928599f2e830f0a.protected_mechanism: Use representative tasks, access checks and dialogue to test the receiving maintainer’s ability; preserve rationale and unresolved questions that the task exposes.
9e51cfd58de9ba49332e3b53b928599f2e830f0a.retirement_condition: Fund sustainable capacity or choose a feasible alternative. Retire operational systems and artefacts when their justified consumers/obligations end, preserving only required historical custody.

9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: A local fault has a justified impact boundary and no demonstrated need for broad redesign. Choose among continued maintenance, local repair, wrapping, rehosting, replatforming, restructuring, incremental/atomic replacement and retirement.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Coexistence requires a supported version/state protocol and an account of which representation is authoritative.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Locality is justified and the patch does not merely defer a spreading failure. Undocumented domain knowledge and imperfect data semantics can dominate migration difficulty.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Identify cutover seams, dual writes, external consumers and transitions where old/new states cannot be kept equivalent.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: No change is cheaper where the reported behaviour is acceptable; a focused correction is cheaper than modernisation when adequate. Include temporary duplication, conversion and exit costs; keep old service only while justified and actually close retired paths.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Legacy experts, successor maintainers, operators and affected customers must coordinate cutover and accepted losses.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Endpoint tests do not establish intermediate-state integrity; reconciliation and failed-observation paths are necessary.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: User needing restoration and maintainer bearing repair risk. Migration invariants specify what users, data consumers and operators must continue to observe and what may deliberately change.
9e5ba3aea55f4a69f9c79d228222ba5c8873fa4a.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Locate irreversible conversion or external-effect steps; distinguish true reversal from loss-tolerant restore and forward reconciliation.

d8e9c7040da0e04e886430b1b9eac8bc20703a1e.TRIGGER_CONTEXT: Several controls interact, compete for finite maintenance capacity or persist after their original obligations change.

definitions.d93c59888ba95775ce0c3c9aa8a58035cfce0240: Disposition conflict resolved by separating authority objects. A calls generated-insight authority a duplicate of goal authorisation; B distinguishes proposal, acceptance and execution powers. A person may authorise a goal without delegating deployment or external-state mutation. Keep that distinct boundary, while rejecting an AI-only second approval ceremony. Preserve A’s duplicate verdict verbatim.

FINDINGS: Source-supported: transfer experiences show knowledge is not exhausted by documents. Analytical: expert memory can also be wrong.
Memory and documentation can be wrong or stale; history does not make a past choice permanently binding.
Agreement among incomplete views is not complete understanding. A slice preserves a criterion under its model, not arbitrary external behaviour.

definitions.d9501bf2dd9cc79c445cdc431c3e1ed856ee31ee: Hold a formal model/premises fixed and its theorem survives missing implementation correspondence. If the native operation changes the model input or reachable-state account, re-evaluate that particular result. A finite pending run is not an infinite noncompletion proof. Missing implementation/activity evidence withholds that transfer; it does not refute a fixed model result.
d98087068dece005766449de1e9653c92032a035: The useful obligation, support interval, stable environment assumptions, change-benefit comparison and reopening signal are independent.
No-change is a deliberate decision alternative, not a general claim that any inactivity is safe.
Known breach, missing observation and independently changed obligations have different consequences; an action fact neither selects nor authorizes intervention.

ACCOUNT.critical_assumption: Containment scope, operational capability and recovery or follow-up must be credible.
ACCOUNT.discriminating_question: What event ends the emergency exception, and who accepts residual loss?

da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.BASELINE_AND_AFFECTED_ARTEFACTS: Bind evidence and decisions to the actual candidate, baseline and relevant state. Joint deployment/migration states may be objects in their own right.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: Evidence crosses a tool/person boundary, concurrent work changes the candidate, or a method uses results to authorise action. The composite maintains a useful system under legitimate changing objectives; it does not maximise activity, code cleanliness, automation or documentation.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Choose local change, bounded automation, coexistence, quiescent migration, non-change or retirement under explicit guards; do not require every technique simultaneously.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Identifiable objects and obligations, traceable evidence scope and a consumer with actual authority and capability. No actor needs complete knowledge of the whole system, but consequential information must reach an appropriate decision consumer.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Composition can create interference or temporary dependencies absent from components. Re-evaluate relevant edges when candidate or assumptions change.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Analysts communicate evidence; authorised actors accept and operate; achieved consequences require observation after action.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: This relation is a reasoned synthesis, not an empirically validated universal protocol; excessive invalidation can cause rechecking cascades and delay. Independent-looking checks can share stale baselines or wrong oracles. Positive local results cannot alone validate the composed outcome.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: The actual accepted/deployed candidate is the one supported by the still-applicable evidence, or gaps are explicitly accepted within authority. Carry intended and preserved obligations across handoffs; distinguish knowing a criterion, authority/capability to act and realised consequences.
da0a0fd9d07f2120f5c3b4e30668e2d35af2459d.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Couple release choice to actual data/effect recovery or forward repair. Interrupts can stop exposure and reopen earlier judgements without a forced serial pipeline.

da194a82ecb62819f5b17432906f36256e6f27ad.anti_ceremony: Presence of an artefact, tool name, meeting or metric does not establish the postcondition; remove it when its protected failure and consumer disappear.
da194a82ecb62819f5b17432906f36256e6f27ad.essential: The ordering objective is stated and omitted tests, if any, remain known.
da194a82ecb62819f5b17432906f36256e6f27ad.minimal_alternative: Keep the existing order when the suite is cheap or priority estimates are unreliable.

da358f77b35021ae6fbc7342b77b6892a711138f.cost_of_simplification: Direct contact with known callers cannot establish the absence of other consumers; retain a notice or compatibility interval where undiscovered use is plausible.
da358f77b35021ae6fbc7342b77b6892a711138f.fuller_form_trigger: A public or shared behaviour, data format, dependency or support promise changes.
da358f77b35021ae6fbc7342b77b6892a711138f.minimal_adequate_alternative: For a private bounded use with no external consumer, direct coordination with the local caller may suffice.
da358f77b35021ae6fbc7342b77b6892a711138f.protected_mechanism: Identify plausible consumers through interfaces, usage, dependency data and consultation; disclose uncertainty and notify those needing action.
da358f77b35021ae6fbc7342b77b6892a711138f.retirement_condition: Balance broader investigation against false-positive work. Stop maintaining dependency representations when no decision consumes them, not while hidden critical dependencies remain.

da51a5d37ac386797eafbac13cbdd6c1ed7fb933.additional_qualification: Cunningham's 1992 experience metaphor is not a financial measurement system or a label for every defect. Later definitions may broaden the idea without establishing universal interest rates.
da51a5d37ac386797eafbac13cbdd6c1ed7fb933.discriminating_evaluation: State a causal cost mechanism and comparator; remove the label when the relevant future work disappears.
da51a5d37ac386797eafbac13cbdd6c1ed7fb933.scope_and_quantification: For a concrete present choice and the future task class in which it could impose additional burden over a plausible horizon.

ACTOR_AUTHORITY_BOUNDARY.value: Existing legitimate decision authority remains; removal of ceremony does not permit unauthorised changes.

CRITERION.value: The decision is adequately authorised and informed whether or not a meeting occurs.

DEPENDENCIES_PRECONDITIONS.value: A real unresolved cross-party decision or external requirement is needed to justify the fuller form.

value.hypothesis: Reduce bureaucracy without destroying consequential coordination.
value.qualification: Conditional payoff, not a guarantee or a measured effect unless explicitly established by an individual empirical source.

MECHANISM.value: Strip the mandatory ritual while preserving appropriate authorisation, consultation and evidence; use a fuller forum only when conflicts or obligations require it.

NON_TRIGGER_CHEAP_PATH.value: A direct authorised maintainer decision can suffice for a bounded change.

OBSERVABLE_POSTCONDITION.value: The decision is adequately authorised and informed whether or not a meeting occurs.

QUESTIONS: When does a multi-party forum resolve conflicts more effectively than direct accountable decisions?

OUTPUTS_EVIDENCE_CONSTRAINTS.value: The decision is adequately authorised and informed whether or not a meeting occurs.

REQUIRED_INPUTS.value: A real unresolved cross-party decision or external requirement is needed to justify the fuller form.

SUBJECT_BEARER.value: Identify the system/configuration being changed and any non-code artefact needed to interpret the request. A source commit alone may omit deployed data and obligations.

TRIGGER_CONTEXT.value: Adjudicate when the presence of a board is treated as the maintenance property itself.

definitions.da6859d2d6d9a7c024c64cde794e23452bda0552: Remove an exact duplicate and protection can remain. Remove the last actual relevant failure/observation check and the example can accept the unsupported result. Remove the named source label while keeping the direct actual binding and classification survives. Remove the last actual activity evidence and it remains pending. Remove the named practice and adequate direct evidence remains; remove the last fact and the component stays pending. No global conformance or review ritual is created. Remove the last actual fact and the component is pending; remove a replaceable framework and an adequate cheap path remains. Current r14: Remove replaceable ceremony and the native function can survive; remove the last actual fact or legitimate mandate and this comparison does not. Current r15: Remove D and finite protection survives; remove F or G and a declared failure escapes. Short horizon may retain the existing adequate method. Existing C105/C064 explain the distinction without a new optimizer.

da8381c19662d5408a9e5363c8307c1ff2bccfa0.mechanism: At a transfer or continuity risk, establish that an actual willing recipient has the knowledge, access, time and practical ability to perform representative supported work; use explanation, supervised work or equivalent evidence.
da8381c19662d5408a9e5363c8307c1ff2bccfa0.postcondition: The recipient can perform the relevant supported work, or the remaining capability/support limitation is explicit and acted upon.

QUESTIONS: Which uncertainty could reverse the preferred option, and is more information worth its cost?
How should irreversible option loss and costs shifted to future maintainers be represented without spurious precision?

da8cf09391f57fdeeb01c7b55377dfc886f58f61.mechanism: Check a declared, justified architectural constraint against appropriately extracted or observed relationships; attach the relevant baseline, mapping and evidence to each finding.
da8cf09391f57fdeeb01c7b55377dfc886f58f61.postcondition: A finding identifies an actual relation, the applicable rule and the protected concern, allowing informed adjudication.

actor.principal_basis: Analytical role; actual PID/UID captured, no institutional authentication claim.

dad4d4ee20ca1db6dc9a3080ca2024f2589d34d1.basis: Chikofsky and Cross distinguish reverse engineering, redocumentation, design recovery, restructuring and re-engineering.
dad4d4ee20ca1db6dc9a3080ca2024f2589d34d1.extraction_rule: Distinct trigger, mechanism or evidential disposition; maintained in the full denominator even if rejected or duplicated.

definitions.daf3113f1dcf72f0bc341eb5fa23070bab926460: Both native triggers apply to one specified changed shared surface and its actual supported or plausibly affected reliance. Bind product/artifact, relevant version/configuration, observer, support promise and horizon. The named source output must actually be consumed; neither co-location in a workflow nor a shared term is sufficient. The admitted option has an actual named consumer/support path and that option or support promise is changing.
definitions.daf33816b473b08235c16bcf5d72a0bb596a1188: Choose the representative dependency/interaction question that a recipient must actually answer. The actual supplied dependency-kind/extraction-scope or connector/state/completion fact changes the recorded native operand as shown by this executed receiving operation. A standalone purpose label, unchanged formal result or missing full-property conclusion does not remove this conditional component use. The independent premises remain independent.

daf409a51ef93f93b26c61339e539f357a1b173e.account: Every constituent technique has costs, prerequisites and non-trigger cases; their conjunction is not a universal workflow.
daf409a51ef93f93b26c61339e539f357a1b173e.attribution_limit: No chronological-first or causal-influence claim follows solely from this antecedent list.

db023a09f6e67e49d0bd5b8c1322e1540ba0664c.cheap_or_nontrigger: For infrequent bounded changes, a direct outcome review may suffice; do not institute a metric programme without a decision consumer.
db023a09f6e67e49d0bd5b8c1322e1540ba0664c.failure_test: Time-series association and fitted curves do not identify causal feedback. Measures can be gamed and external shocks confound trends.
db023a09f6e67e49d0bd5b8c1322e1540ba0664c.needed: Consistent measurement boundaries, interpretable observations and authority to change priorities.

db07c9ff41275bee3e577b1a177c16d1df7a74e1.discriminating_evaluation: Determine whether every fault-revealing test in T is selected under the actual supported dependency model; compare total analysis and execution cost with retest-all.
db07c9ff41275bee3e577b1a177c16d1df7a74e1.scope_and_quantification: For the existing nonobsolete suite T and program pair under the controlled-regression assumptions, at the selected test execution.

db09cca1dbd20832cab8eb93b168a2d8d4537165.current_assessment: Preserve exact native evidence roles, dependence cluster and claim ceilings; apply only the actual new access judgments in listed groups.
db09cca1dbd20832cab8eb93b168a2d8d4537165.upgrade_rule: A discovered later version or source opening is not independent replication or automatic claim upgrade.

db12fa3c3253612b66f06d7b0c6d1faa95cc4af4: Configuration constraint A implies C, the supported domain, feature map, protected resource criterion and three-slot budget are separately declared analytical premises.

One slot per check is a stipulated budget model, not measured time or a claim that exhaustive checking is impractical in general. Other critical combinations and environmental/higher-order limits remain.

db2ab60810ae75cb19a1a4561900052ff765a3aa.countercontrol_and_adequate_alternative: One correct direct product-to-action map can replace a longer multi-register chain. Typed paths are required only for the actual decision, not every conceivable global dependency.
db2ab60810ae75cb19a1a4561900052ff765a3aa.operative_guard: Every bridge refers to the same version, actual artifact use and recipient role; missing links stay unknown. The reverse observation is newly produced in the action task rather than a table independently supplied to both analyses.
db2ab60810ae75cb19a1a4561900052ff765a3aa.remaining_limit: The seven broad unresolved questions and open-world completeness limits remain. C025/C022 already cover the relevant closure obligation at their triggers.

db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.lineage_removal_and_simpler_alternative: One honestly scoped source account can replace duplicate corroboration claims. No additional independent review is claimed for root support.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.native_bearer: The synthesis's evidence account and claimed corroboration, not the target software.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.native_criterion: Do not multiply support when local properties reuse the same work, programme, dataset or access-limited claim.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r11_causal_scope: C018 activity-discriminator correction; previous sufficient parents, full bearer, criterion and alternatives retained.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r12_causal_scope: Actual conformance-produced partial input and native applicability, realization and proportionality consequences; prior parents/bearer/criterion retained.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r13_causal_scope: Partial native input and separate receiving use; no new qualified property.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r14_causal_scope: Bound native use only; inherited evidence remains at its own original scope.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r14_impact: Actual native action/decision operand examined; existing parents suffice.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r15_causal_scope: Finite actual native use with independent analytical premises; no empirical or global-completeness inference.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r15_impact: Actual native protection/decision operand examined; existing qualified parents suffice.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r16_causal_scope: Existing operation/evidence binding and combined-control parents explain the correction; no new native identity or all-three-lineage necessity.
db374b4282a722c7230c0a72372674cc1b8747ca.r16_impact: A fresh exposed author, sealed reviewer witness and historical author executions have separate identities. New source and prospective cases are not field replications.

ACCOUNT.adjudication: Source-supported: wrong patches, omitted regressions, broken harnesses and issue/PR misalignment provide counterexamples.
ACCOUNT.effect_on_disposition: Reject the universal inference, not the utility of tests.

CRITERION.value: Impact reasoning identifies relevant edge kinds and their limits, including consequential non-code propagation.

value.hypothesis: Prevent testing the wrong generated output or missing a consequential resource edit.
value.qualification: A conditional engineering rationale, not a universal quantified or experimentally certified payoff.

MECHANISM.value: Represent the dependency types that can propagate the actual change, including build, generated, runtime, data and organisational/interface edges where consequential; distinguish observed or inferred edges from necessary ones.

NON_TRIGGER_CHEAP_PATH.value: A recorded explicit command and input list suffice where there is no indirect generation or configuration.

OBSERVABLE_POSTCONDITION.value: Impact reasoning identifies relevant edge kinds and their limits, including consequential non-code propagation.

OUTPUTS_EVIDENCE_CONSTRAINTS.value: Impact reasoning identifies relevant edge kinds and their limits, including consequential non-code propagation.

SUBJECT_BEARER.value: Build scripts, resources, schemas, generated code, package inputs and tool versions. Include code, APIs, data, configuration, generated artefacts, builds, release combinations and downstream consumers.

TRIGGER_CONTEXT.value: Non-source inputs or generators influence the target behaviour or regression selection.

dbab154ae905d46bf85b7fa722c55cb5e5986fb9.additional_qualification: Original accepted-for-future-conference wording remains a historical observation. Fresh programme metadata establishes scheduled publication context, not a replication or actual delivered presentation.
dbab154ae905d46bf85b7fa722c55cb5e5986fb9.discriminating_evaluation: Identify which claim depends on the changed model, prompt, hardware or environment; recheck only affected conclusions.
dbab154ae905d46bf85b7fa722c55cb5e5986fb9.scope_and_quantification: For prior tool or model evidence whose premises might change at the actual version/configuration transition.

ACCOUNT.adjudication: Source-supported: empirical growth trajectories vary. Analytical: demand for more features is not automatically legitimate value.
ACCOUNT.effect_on_disposition: Retain feedback and reject a universal prescription for continuing growth.

dbbda40a338362df6ee3fd82dc44ccb0e7d92d95.fresh_evidence_limit: Only the cited new access events supply fresh evidence, each at its stated passage/design scope. Empty fresh list means the reviewed native evidence remains inherited; it does not mean the material row was left unexamined.
dbbda40a338362df6ee3fd82dc44ccb0e7d92d95.polarity_rule: The adverse candidate and the guarded corrective criterion are different propositions. The native disposition applies to the candidate; evaluating a good corrective action does not turn a rejected universal into a retained universal.

dbf395ebfe1ca2d2e1e0f70e59cc41fca515c312.mechanism: Revise a method, threshold or oracle only for an authorised failure/benefit hypothesis or separately authorised objective change, using evidence not constituted merely by the candidate satisfying its newly chosen rule; preserve unrelated predecessor obligations.
dbf395ebfe1ca2d2e1e0f70e59cc41fca515c312.postcondition: The revision and any change of obligation have a bounded non-circular warrant; unchanged obligations remain in force and the successor does not grant itself wider authority.

dc32aa2c5b9468e0c202acd0b6c8f2bb795e32c9.account: Disposal scope and policy examples do not establish a universal retirement procedure; external obligations require target-specific evidence beyond this study.
dc32aa2c5b9468e0c202acd0b6c8f2bb795e32c9.distinction: The sources’ findings and this researcher’s extrapolation/critique are separated in the criticism ledger and source limits.

dc4a835a8bbebe6d64725775d8fbb39b58eb9fa0.meaning_scope: Complete44nativefields remain authoritative; this short assessment is not a substitute or a new property.
dc4a835a8bbebe6d64725775d8fbb39b58eb9fa0.name: Impact and regression analysis of shared changes
dc4a835a8bbebe6d64725775d8fbb39b58eb9fa0.new_author_assessment: Shared changes propagate only through affected dependences; unchanged names cannot establish regression safety. Product-specific checks can remain necessary.

dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.BASELINE_AND_AFFECTED_ARTEFACTS: Release candidate, control, traffic population, data/configuration and monitoring. Bind tests, results, build inputs, artefact identity, environment, deployed versions and relevant data state.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.CHANGE_INTENT_AND_CHANGE_CLASS: Production-only uncertainties can be investigated with genuinely limited and reversible exposure. Separate the newly intended effect from independent obligations intended to survive a release.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.COMPATIBILITY_AND_MIGRATION_PRECONDITION: Mixed versions and schema transitions require accepted intermediate states, not just endpoint compatibility.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.COMPREHENSION_ASSUMPTIONS: Isolation, representativeness, measurement sensitivity and authority to halt must exist. Maintainers must know test and environment omissions, while operators must understand release and recovery conditions.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.IMPACT_BOUNDARY_AND_DEPENDENCY_EVIDENCE: Test selection and release sampling cover declared dependency/traffic boundaries; shared state can defeat assumed isolation.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.LIFECYCLE_COST_AND_RETIREMENT_CONDITION: Use direct release with proportionate checks for low-impact changes, or offline rehearsal where live exposure is unsafe. Testing and rollout costs must be proportional to loss exposure; remove redundant checks, not the last evidence for a live obligation.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.MAINTAINER_AND_DOWNSTREAM_CONSUMERS: Developers, release operators and downstream users exchange version identity, acceptance evidence, exposure decisions and incident observations.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.ORACLE_AND_REGRESSION_LIMITS: Tests can encode old faults, miss rare behaviour or use broken harnesses; independent evidence must address consequential omissions.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.PRESERVATION_OBLIGATION_AND_OBSERVER: Real users and operators observing relevant service consequences. An oracle is a source of expected behaviour with assumptions, not the fact that a test happened to pass.
dc8e13949e767ae3017b93418596f008d1f07ad2.RELEASE_ROLLBACK_OR_FORWARD_REPAIR_CONDI: Specify whether recovery means code reversion, data restoration, compensation, containment or forward repair, with evidence of feasibility.

dcae4bbeb78c0e6572d0645e75af2272cb95382f.cheap_or_nontrigger: Retain an adapter when a real consumer still requires it; do not remove it solely to satisfy a cleanup schedule.
dcae4bbeb78c0e6572d0645e75af2272cb95382f.failure_test: Premature removal can strand consumers or eliminate recovery; zero duplication is not a universal objective.
dcae4bbeb78c0e6572d0645e75af2272cb95382f.needed: Evidence of consumer transition, settled data authority and expiry or replacement of recovery obligations.

definitions.dcc2ceea988b466d073cf64e3cab71ee423dbcb7: Dependency viability needs actual technical compatibility, available means, support capacity, relevant consumer knowledge and any legitimate obligations. A chart or ownership label cannot establish these. Missing decoder or response route is a particular practical deficiency; withdrawal of chart-only warrant leaves consumer scope unknown until independently evidenced. Closure alone does not supply a retained-use dependency.

dccd6d42b1edb715e5e305da399330410f40d741.cheap_or_nontrigger: Use an existing trustworthy archive and identifiers rather than maintaining a duplicate live service.
dccd6d42b1edb715e5e305da399330410f40d741.failure_test: Software Heritage explicitly separates a comprehensive corpus from curation and buildability; environments and external services may still disappear.
dccd6d42b1edb715e5e305da399330410f40d741.needed: Permission to retain/distribute material, adequate identifiers and a retention purpose; private data and credentials require separate treatment.

dcde497b6a3a99dc0fb1e203bc79d85fe84b635e.countercontrol_and_adequate_alternative: Use product-specific instructions and a cheaper adequate local response when the aggregate policy does not fit.
dcde497b6a3a99dc0fb1e203bc79d85fe84b635e.operative_guard: Realized product, action distinction, external cost and horizon are explicit.
dcde497b6a3a99dc0fb1e203bc79d85fe84b635e.remaining_limit: No field prevalence or aggregate-benefit claim is supplied.
dcde497b6a3a99dc0fb1e203bc79d85fe84b635e.scientific_reassessment: A population aggregate, high local score or large contact count can hide an individual supported recipient’s required action or hard limit.

dcee339d4c4d47bfd80bdc28e231d8a0a46f6019.mere_convergence_or_application_test: Retain the enumerated relation/cluster or unresolved capability question instead of assigning a surviving SSS-E ID.
dcee339d4c4d47bfd80bdc28e231d8a0a46f6019.warning: The removal tests distinguish loss of a concrete example/input, loss of a sufficiency argument and novel-predicate status. They do not claim that arbitrary premise removal preserves the proposed property.

dd1b56854430a574249250a95312c88c7a9bbf4b.anti_ceremony: Presence of an artefact, tool name, meeting or metric does not establish the postcondition; remove it when its protected failure and consumer disappear.
dd1b56854430a574249250a95312c88c7a9bbf4b.essential: The impact claim covers relevant non-code/model dependencies or explicitly marks unknowns.
dd1b56854430a574249250a95312c88c7a9bbf4b.minimal_alternative: Ordinary code/configuration analysis is enough when no learned or changing data dependency is present.

COMPARATIVE_EMPIRICAL_SUPPORT.basis: Consult individual source EMPIRICAL_PROFILE records for actual units, comparisons and limits; do not infer a general causal effect from the retained status.

CONTRARY_EVIDENCE.basis: The inspected study trades greater static recall for lower precision; many cases reuse earlier datasets and unsupported cases limit generality.

FIELD_OR_DEPLOYMENT_SUPPORT.assessment: not established as a direct deployment comparison for this property
FIELD_OR_DEPLOYMENT_SUPPORT.basis: Find semantic regressions invisible to textual merge checks. This payoff is an engineering hypothesis unless an individual source directly measured it.

HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.assessment: strong for identified works, not for an invented unified school
HISTORICAL_PROVENANCE.basis: Original forms and source editions are separated from later interpretations. Static information-flow and dynamic tests attempt to detect semantic interference in textually mergeable changes.

REPLICATION.assessment: not established as independent replication of this entire property
REPLICATION.basis: Source-dependence register preserves common projects, datasets, programmes, reviews and editions. More citations are not more replications.

dd3522a7a9544e228f0ff4422aa812d8624d09eb.predicate_vs_example_result: The inherited criterion set survives; the example loses a lineage-specific argument, not a new predicate.
dd3522a7a9544e228f0ff4422aa812d8624d09eb.result: The full example loses a domain-specific input or an inherited criterion. No warranted distinct SSS invariant was established even before removal; necessity of this example's vocabulary is not necessity for a new predicate.

dd3b418d547ebe825909d8ae7475aafa7e5aad05.fresh_evidence_limit: Only the cited new access events supply fresh evidence, each at its stated passage/design scope. Empty fresh list means the reviewed native evidence remains inherited; it does not mean the material row was left unexamined.
dd3b418d547ebe825909d8ae7475aafa7e5aad05.polarity_rule: The selected criterion is evaluated under its stated guard and premises; ancestry can contain an opposite-polarity or narrower candidate with its own unchanged status.

definitions.dd4dfe4a0486550eb6a28797e30685bd029c3323: Representative unseen tasks, reliable independent oracles, end-to-end outcomes, long-term follow-up and legitimate operational authority would be needed. Leakage, weak oracles, selected populations and narrow deployments leave major transfer gaps. Rapid tool change also prevents treating old adverse evidence as a permanent limit.

dd62d25bd6b24ac7b9ab2b7c71f85575ef3f8874.cost_of_simplification: A visible local diff and check may not survive distributed handoffs or concurrent edits; enrich binding when stale evidence can reach another actor.
dd62d25bd6b24ac7b9ab2b7c71f85575ef3f8874.fuller_form_trigger: Evidence crosses a tool/person boundary, concurrent work changes the candidate, or a method uses results to authorise action.
